comment: Per-frame checks on the posed LOD0 meshes (mm, deg), MECHANIC_W86 v03 clips on the v02 wrench. skin = Body (closed mesh, without the right forearm and hand) signed distance to the wrench outside the grip; cloth = nearest Outfit vertex (unsigned); face = Face mesh signed; floor = lowest wrench point above the boot soles; lefthand = left mitten vs the wrench (into = deepest overlap, within 4 mm = contact); axis = ray from the rear jaw tip backward along the shank (aim frames with the left hand on); wrists: forearm vs hand total bend.
